tbesh_html:
: wash
1) to wash, wash off, wash away, bathe
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to wash, wash off, wash away
1a2) to wash, bathe (oneself)
1b) (Pual) to be washed
1c) (Hithpael) to wash oneself
2a) (Hithpael Passive) to be regarded clean, trustworthy

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to lave (the whole or a part of a thing)

occurrences.bsb: Let a little water be brought, that you may wash your feet and rest yourselves under the tree.
occurrences.kjv: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

occurrences.bsb: and said, “My lords, please turn aside into the house of your servant; wash your feet and spend the night. Then you can rise early and go on your way.” “No,” they answered, “we will spend the night in the square.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

occurrences.bsb: So the man came to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and feed were brought to the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of his companions.
occurrences.kjv: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that were with him.

occurrences.bsb: And the steward took the men into Joseph’s house, gave them water to wash their feet, and provided food for their donkeys.
occurrences.kjv: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

occurrences.bsb: Then he washed his face and came back out. Regaining his composure, he said, “Serve the meal.”
occurrences.kjv: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

occurrences.bsb: Soon the daughter of Pharaoh went down to bathe in the Nile, and her attendants were walking along the riverbank. And when she saw the basket among the reeds, she sent her maidservant to retrieve it.
occurrences.kjv: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

occurrences.bsb: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
occurrences.kjv: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.

occurrences.bsb: Cut the ram into pieces, wash the entrails and legs, and place them with its head and other pieces.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.

occurrences.bsb: “You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Set it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it,
occurrences.kjv: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

occurrences.bsb: with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet.
occurrences.kjv: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

occurrences.bsb: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister by presenting a food offering to the LORD, they must wash with water so that they will not die.
occurrences.kjv: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: Thus they are to wash their hands and feet so that they will not die; this shall be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.”
occurrences.kjv: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

occurrences.bsb: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

occurrences.bsb: He placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing;
occurrences.kjv: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.

occurrences.bsb: and from it Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and feet.
occurrences.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

occurrences.bsb: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
occurrences.kjv: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the Lord commanded Moses.

occurrences.bsb: The entrails and legs must be washed with water, and the priest shall burn all of it on the altar as a burnt offering, a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: The entrails and legs must be washed with water, and the priest shall present all of it and burn it on the altar; it is a burnt offering, a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Then Moses presented Aaron and his sons and washed them with water.
occurrences.kjv: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

occurrences.bsb: He washed the entrails and legs with water and burned the entire ram on the altar as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
occurrences.kjv: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

occurrences.bsb: He washed the entrails and the legs and burned them atop the burnt offering on the altar.
occurrences.kjv: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.

occurrences.bsb: The one being cleansed must wash his clothes, shave off all his hair, and bathe with water; then he will be ceremonially clean. Afterward, he may enter the camp, but he must remain outside his tent for seven days.
occurrences.kjv: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

occurrences.bsb: On the seventh day he must shave off all his hair—his head, his beard, his eyebrows, and the rest of his hair. He must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and he will be clean.
occurrences.kjv: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever sits on furniture on which the man with the discharge was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever touches the body of the man with a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: If the man with the discharge spits on one who is clean, that person must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever touches anything that was under him will be unclean until evening, and whoever carries such things must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: If the man with the discharge touches anyone without first rinsing his hands with water, the one who was touched must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: When the man has been cleansed from his discharge, he must count off seven days for his cleansing, wash his clothes, and bathe himself in fresh water, and he shall be clean.
occurrences.kjv: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

occurrences.bsb: When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, both must bathe with water, and they will remain unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: and anyone who touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: Whoever touches any furniture on which she was sitting must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: Anyone who touches these things will be unclean; he must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: He is to wear the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments. He must tie a linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are holy garments, and he must bathe himself with water before he wears them.
occurrences.kjv: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.

occurrences.bsb: He is to bathe himself with water in a holy place and put on his own clothes. Then he must go out and sacrifice his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering to make atonement for himself and for the people.
occurrences.kjv: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

occurrences.bsb: The man who released the goat as the scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may reenter the camp.
occurrences.kjv: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

occurrences.bsb: The one who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and afterward he may reenter the camp.
occurrences.kjv: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

occurrences.bsb: And any person, whether native or foreigner, who eats anything found dead or mauled by wild beasts must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean until evening; then he will be clean.
occurrences.kjv: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

occurrences.bsb: But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe himself, then he shall bear his iniquity.”
occurrences.kjv: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.

occurrences.bsb: the man who touches any of these will remain unclean until evening. He must not eat from the sacred offerings unless he has bathed himself with water.
occurrences.kjv: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.

occurrences.bsb: Then the priest must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water; after that he may enter the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: The one who burned the heifer must also wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and he too will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
occurrences.kjv: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

occurrences.bsb: The man who is ceremonially clean is to sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day. After he purifies the unclean person on the seventh day, the one being cleansed must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and that evening he will be clean.
occurrences.kjv: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

occurrences.bsb: Then all the elders of the city nearest the victim shall wash their hands by the stream over the heifer whose neck has been broken,
occurrences.kjv: And all the elders of that city, that are next unto the slain man, shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley:

occurrences.bsb: When evening approaches, he must wash with water, and when the sun sets he may return to the camp.
occurrences.kjv: But it shall be, when evening cometh on, he shall wash himself with water: and when the sun is down, he shall come into the camp again.

occurrences.bsb: So he brought him to his house and fed his donkeys. And they washed their feet and ate and drank.
occurrences.kjv: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore wash yourself, put on perfume, and wear your best clothes. Go down to the threshing floor, but do not let the man know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.
occurrences.kjv: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the floor: but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.

occurrences.bsb: She arose, bowed facedown, and said, “Here is your servant, ready to serve and to wash the feet of my lord’s servants.”
occurrences.kjv: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

occurrences.bsb: One evening David got up from his bed and strolled around on the roof of the palace. And from the roof he saw a woman bathing—a very beautiful woman.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king’s house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

occurrences.bsb: Then he said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king followed him.
occurrences.kjv: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.

occurrences.bsb: Then David got up from the ground, washed and anointed himself, changed his clothes, and went into the house of the LORD and worshiped. Then he went to his own house, and at his request they set food before him, and he ate.
occurrences.kjv: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the Lord, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.

occurrences.bsb: And the chariot was washed at the pool of Samaria where the prostitutes bathed, and the dogs licked up Ahab’s blood, according to the word that the LORD had spoken.
occurrences.kjv: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the Lord which he spake.

occurrences.bsb: Then Elisha sent him a messenger, who said, “Go and wash yourself seven times in the Jordan, and your flesh will be restored, and you will be clean.”
occurrences.kjv: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.

occurrences.bsb: Are not the Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Could I not have washed in them and been cleansed?” So he turned and went away in a rage.
occurrences.kjv: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

occurrences.bsb: Naaman’s servants, however, approached him and said, “My father, if the prophet had told you to do some great thing, would you not have done it? How much more, then, when he tells you, ‘Wash and be cleansed’?”
occurrences.kjv: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?

occurrences.bsb: He also made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north. The parts of the burnt offering were rinsed in them, but the priests used the Sea for washing.
occurrences.kjv: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

occurrences.bsb: If I should wash myself with snow and cleanse my hands with lye,
occurrences.kjv: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

occurrences.bsb: when my steps were bathed in cream and the rock poured out for me streams of oil!
occurrences.kjv: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

occurrences.bsb: I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD,
occurrences.kjv: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O Lord:

occurrences.bsb: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
occurrences.kjv: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

occurrences.bsb: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
occurrences.kjv: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

occurrences.bsb: There is a generation of those who are pure in their own eyes and yet unwashed of their filth.
occurrences.kjv: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.

occurrences.bsb: I have taken off my robe—must I put it back on? I have washed my feet—must I soil them again?
occurrences.kjv: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?

occurrences.bsb: His eyes are like doves beside the streams of water, bathed in milk and mounted like jewels.
occurrences.kjv: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, and fitly set.

occurrences.bsb: Wash and cleanse yourselves. Remove your evil deeds from My sight. Stop doing evil!
occurrences.kjv: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;

occurrences.bsb: when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and cleansed the bloodstains from the heart of Jerusalem by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of fire.
occurrences.kjv: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.

occurrences.bsb: On the day of your birth your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water for cleansing. You were not rubbed with salt or wrapped in cloths.
occurrences.kjv: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

occurrences.bsb: Then I bathed you with water, rinsed off your blood, and anointed you with oil.
occurrences.kjv: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.

occurrences.bsb: Furthermore, you sisters sent messengers for men who came from afar; and behold, when they arrived, you bathed for them, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with jewelry.
occurrences.kjv: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
